title: The Finance tab menu of a closed work order offers Reopen only
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reopen Work Order" only; there is no "Issue Credit" and no "Reverse".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R6: “The asset Invoices tab lists the closed work order with status Closed, the badge, Total balance "No Charge" and Discount and Tax rate empty (rows on that tab have no actions). The customer's Invoices tab (the receivables ledger) does not list it; the customer's Work Orders tab does (S2-R10). GET /api/invoices/list leaves it out too (no screen uses it today). Customer statements, the customer balance and credit limit checks do not include it, and no message driven by an open balance can pick it up, since it carries none. The Finance tab menu of the closed work order offers Reopen Work Order only (S4-R1); Issue Credit is not shown, as there is nothing to credit.”
  • S4-R1: “On a closed internal or no-charge work order the Finance tab's invoice menu shows "Reopen Work Order" where a billable work order shows "Reverse", and no Issue Credit. It is the only place to reopen; the work order header carries the line of S2-R9 and no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "10b Asset · Invoices tab" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "05 Finance tab · closed" (page "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order"), "29 Closed · NO CHARGE document" (page "Happy flow v6").
